variables.name: X_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID
variables.title: X OAuth 2.0 Client ID
variables.description: Client ID under 'OAuth 2.0 Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens.

variables.name: X_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.title: X OAuth 2.0 Client Secret (Optional for public clients)
variables.description: Client Secret under 'OAuth 2.0 Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens (optional for public PKCE clients).

variables.name: X_OAUTH2_REFRESH_TOKEN
variables.title: X OAuth 2.0 Refresh Token (Optional — paste from Console 'Generate', or leave blank for browser PKCE login)
variables.description: Optional long-term OAuth 2.0 Refresh Token from 'OAuth 2.0 Keys -> Access Token -> Generate' in https://console.x.com (recommended for zero-callback long-term auth, or leave blank to authorize via browser PKCE).
